Chapter 679: Chapter 13: Time Achieved (5000 Words, Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 679: Chapter 13: Time Achieved (5000 words, please subscribe)_2

Indeed.

Before the birth of a Supreme Being, human civilization dare not make contact with the outside world.

The encounter was so significant that the slightest leak would result in being hunted by all life in the universe.

Starry Sea Era, the first year, human civilization birthed its first Supreme Being.

Starry Sea Era year 1,300, human civilization birthed its second Supreme Being.

Starry Sea Era year 5,700, human civilization birthed its third Supreme Being.

...

Starry Sea Era year 11,000, human civilization birthed its fourth Supreme Being.

Starry Sea Era year 18,000, human civilization birthed its fifth Supreme Being.

Starry Sea Era year 20,000, human civilization birthed its sixth Supreme Being.

Starry Sea Era year 25,000, human civilization birthed its seventh Supreme Being.

Starry Sea Era year 38,000, human civilization birthed its eighth Supreme Being.

Starry Sea Era year 120,000, human civilization birthed its ninth Supreme Being.

Because of that unprecedented encounter, human civilization explosively added nine Supreme Beings in a short period of time.

Of course.

This was the period of utmost splendor for human civilization.

But before the first year of the Starry Sea Era, there were over two million years of dormant months.

The more than two million years of the Starry Sea Era does not mean human civilization only has a history of over two million years.

In fact, the history of the Ancestral Star exceeds tens of billions of years.

“During the dormant months, our human civilization’s strong had to secretly leave the Ancestral Star, posing as lone wanderers in the universe, or sell their services to Different Species in exchange for cultivation resources. Even in death, they could not reveal their origins…”

Lin Yuan said softly.

“Indeed,” Nalan, the deputy tower master, nodded.

In that era, geniuses of human civilization had to keep the lowest of profiles and desperately conceal their talents, or else they might be captured and enslaved by other powerful groups.

Nowadays, countless geniuses of human civilization emerge, and although Different Species occasionally assassinate them, successful assassinations are ultimately few.

And as long as one reaches Sixth Rank, capable of imprinting their life mark, there is hope for Resurrection.

“Who knows what kind of spectacular vision it was when countless treasures fell into the universe, and what kind of encounter it brought to human civilization?”

Nalan, the deputy tower master, said with emotion.

“Countless treasures fell into the universe?”

“Was it that event which caused the great extinction of ninety percent of the species in the universe?”

Lin Yuan’s heart stirred, recalling the results after asking the Goddess of Wisdom to investigate the black planet.

“Does the Galaxy Master also understand this matter?” Nalan, the deputy tower master, was slightly surprised.

He only learned these secrets after stepping into Tier 11, when his status and strength reached the threshold.

Doubtful that the Galaxy Master also knew?

But thinking of the Xia Qin Supreme Being’s regard for the Galaxy Master, Nalan, the deputy tower master, understood.

“Correct.”

“The unprecedented encounter that our human civilization received before the dormant months must have come from that event,” Nalan, the deputy tower master, stated.

Actually, he was only speculating, based on the various pieces of information known so far.

“So that’s how it is.”

Lin Yuan realized in his heart why the Goddess of Wisdom had so quickly found the origins of the black planet.

And she immediately offered a purchase price of five hundred million Merit Points—it turns out she had some understanding of the black planet.

“My gourd…” Lin Yuan suddenly remembered the Mysterious Gourd obtained from cleansing the Milky Way Star Region.

Although human civilization could not find any information about the Mysterious Gourd, Lin Yuan instinctively felt that perhaps this gourd was one of the countless treasures that had fallen into the universe.

Because so far, Lin Yuan hadn’t found any information about the Mysterious Gourd, as if it wasn’t a product of this universe at all.

…

After Nalan, the deputy tower master, left.

A small ripple surfaced in Lin Yuan’s heart.

Nowadays, the majority of human citizens only focused on the valiant military exploits of human civilization sweeping away Different Species in the more than two million years of the Starry Sea Era.

But in reality, the even longer and more ancient dormant years before the Starry Sea Era were also great.

What’s the use of even getting an unprecedented opportunity by luck? Without a difficult dormant period, even the most precious encounters would be looted and occupied by strong beings.

“I must cherish the current environment for cultivation,” Lin Yuan closed his eyes and once again immersed himself in cultivation.

In the blink of an eye, another three years passed.

Lin Yuan had now comprehended two thousand and forty new Rule Models of Time.

He was only ten models away from fully understanding the Rule of Time, as he had expected.

“The two thousand and forty-first Rule Model of Time… Is it a well? The Well of Time?” Lin Yuan’s brows furrowed slightly as he attempted to construct this time rule model.

But all attempts failed.

“The Well of Time…” Lin Yuan fell into deep thought.

“Let’s make another trip to the fifth floor of the Black Tower,” Lin Yuan’s consciousness followed the Magic Jade Mark and directly descended into the Demon Jade Space.

The fifth floor of the Black Tower requires one to have comprehended the Rule of Time in order to overcome its challenges.

That is to say, the many temporal predicaments on the fifth floor are specifically targeted at the various stages of grasping the Rule of Time.

Lin Yuan, leading from effect to cause, combined with insights from the Miniature Universe, the full scope of the River of Time, often achieved significant gains.

Soon.

Lin Yuan arrived in front of the Nine Floors Dark Tower.

At this moment, Stone Statue Shen Ji was chatting leisurely with a burly man.

The burly man, named Yuan Jin, was the second examiner to enter the Demon Jade Space in this universe, and after supplementing some Demonic Evolution Path, he joined the Magic Jade Tower as an ordinary member.

Compared to Lin Yuan, who had comprehended three thousand three hundred thirty-three paths of Demonic Evolution, he naturally fell far short.

But even in the Chaos Void, supplementing the path of Demonic Evolution is a main method for the Magic Jade Tower to recruit members.
